assets.name: The Civilian: MakeHuman body, UAL skeleton
assets.source: tools/zombie/build_bodies.py --variant civilian from MakeHuman (MPFB 2.0.18 basemesh, https://extensions.blender.org/add-ons/mpfb/), the official CC0 MakeHuman clothes namuhekam_male_polo_shirt (a shirts pack, see tools/zombie/build.sh) and cortu_jeans_shorts (a pants pack), and Quaternius' Universal Animation Library 2 (https://opengameart.org/content/universal-animation-library-2): its skeleton, mannequin skin weights and Zombie_Idle_Loop
assets.licence: CC0 (MakeHuman exports and official assets; the clothes' .mhclo files state CC0; UAL2's OpenGameArt page and License.txt state CC0 1.0)
assets.notes: UAL2 is used from the OpenGameArt copy, captured 2026-01-24, before Quaternius' 2026-08-28 licence change. Skeleton and weights only: no Quaternius mesh is in the glTF. The neck and thigh stumps are capped. Textures are not embedded; the game dresses the parts from enemies/zombie/

assets.source: tools/zombie/make_textures.py from cortu_jeans_shorts' jean_shorts_diff.png (https://files2.makehumancommunity.org/asset_packs/pants01/), soiled procedurally, half size, via texpack

assets.name: Civilian polo shirt map
assets.source: tools/zombie/make_textures.py from namuhekam_male_polo_shirt's Polo_Base_Color.png (https://files2.makehumancommunity.org/asset_packs/shirts01/), stained procedurally, half size, via texpack

assets.name: Zombie clips: UAL2 idle, walk and scratch; UAL1 jog, sprint, death and hit, retargeted onto UAL2's skeleton
assets.source: tools/zombie/build_clips.py from Quaternius' Universal Animation Library 2 (https://opengameart.org/content/universal-animation-library-2: Zombie_Idle_Loop, Zombie_Walk_Fwd_Loop, Zombie_Scratch) and Universal Animation Library, the OpenGameArt mirror (https://opengameart.org/content/universal-animation-library, zip https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/universal_animation_librarystandard.zip: Jog_Fwd_Loop, Sprint_Loop, Death01, Hit_Chest)
assets.licence: CC0 (both OpenGameArt pages and their License.txt state CC0 1.0)
assets.notes: Both are used from their OpenGameArt copies, captured before Quaternius' 2026-08-28 licence change (UAL1 on 2025-08-12, UAL2 on 2026-01-24). Animation only: no Quaternius mesh is in the glTF. UAL1's clips are retargeted by world-space rotation onto UAL2's skeleton

assets.name: Crate stacks (kitbash of Poly Haven Wooden Crate 02)
assets.notes: 2- and 3-high stacks of wooden_crate_02 (1K glTF), each crate decimated to ~325 triangles and stretched to a 0.53 m layer, joined into one mesh by tools/props/kitbash.py. Textures are the model's 1K diffuse, nor_gl and arm via texpack

assets.name: Sandbag courses (kitbash of Poly Haven Cement Bag)
assets.notes: 3- and 5-course walls of cement_bag (1K glTF) decimated to ~165 triangles a bag and joined into one mesh by tools/props/kitbash.py. The sack's branded texture is dropped: its UVs are rebuilt as box-projected burlap and it wears materials/hessian_230 (Poly Haven, CC0), tinted khaki
